transcript.text: Prometheus a very powerful monitoring
tool used to collect metrics from
servers Docker containers and even
kubernetes clusters let me show you how
Prometheus actually works at first is
the prometheus. yml file Prometheus uses
a yaml configuration file named prom.
yml which defines how and where to
collect metrics from this file contains
endpoints and intervals to scrape
metrics after you have your config file
ready exporters are used which are demon
surveys used to collect metrics and
expose them into prometheous compatible
format you can visualize these metrics
on grafana dashboard and you can also
set up and send alerts to slack email
telegram anything using Prometheus alert
manager so this is how Prometheus
actually works if you want to know more
about promethus or different devop
schools subscribe to Cloud Chan
